title: Common
description: Definitions shared by the schemas of the SDK language 1.1: the extension bag, attributes, vocabularies, messages and callers.

Ext.description: Extension bag: data a shape carries beyond its fixed fields. Keys are <namespace>.<name>; the namespace is the producing adapter, sdk is the core. Values are JSON. The core copies it and never reads adapter keys.

Attrs.description: Plain attributes a filter or a policy may read (owner, tags, language).

AttrFilter.description: Equality filter on attrs; a list means any of.

Role.description: Message role. Closed; config may add aliases, resolved by adapters at the edge.

TextPart.description: Plain text. The only part the core reads.

MediaPart.description: Image, audio or file. Passed through by the core.

invalid.description: Raw text when the model's arguments did not parse.

CallPart.description: A tool call the model made.

ReasoningPart.description: The model's reasoning, when the backend returns it. Kept in history, never shown as output.

ExtPart.description: Adapter-defined part, type <namespace>.<name>. Passed through untouched, never read by the core.

Part.description: One piece of a message: a core part or an adapter-defined one.

Message.description: One message. parts is always a list. system: text only; user: text and media; assistant: text, reasoning and calls; tool: results only. Adapter parts may appear in any role.

params.description: JSON Schema of the arguments object.

ToolInfo.description: What the model sees of a tool.

ToolMode.description: Whether and which tool the model must call. Default auto.

ModelSettings.description: Sampling settings. The same shape is AgentSpec.settings.

Usage.description: Token counts. Cached or reasoning tokens go in ext.

Finish.description: Why the model stopped. Core values: end, limit, tools, refused, other; config may add values like one of them.

Risk.description: Risk class read by policy. Missing means exec. Core values: read, write, exec; config may add values like one of them.

Action.description: What an access question asks about. Core values: call (a tool), decide and list (approvals, since AuthorizationPort 1.2.0); config may add values like one of them.

PolicyEffect.description: What a policy rule decides. Closed.

GuardLabel.description: What a guard found. Native names go in ext. Core values: pii, secret, injection, toxicity, policy, other; config may add values like one of them.

RunStatus.description: waiting: the run stopped for a human answer and can be resumed. Closed.

StopCode.description: Why a run did not complete. Core values: guard_block, denied, aborted, timeout, limit, hop_limit, needs_input, needs_auth, rejected, error; config may add values like one of them. The run bounds stop with timeout (by sdk.deadline), limit (by sdk.budget) and hop_limit (by sdk.hops).

by.description: Instance that stopped the run: a guard name, an approval adapter, a remote agent, or a core check (sdk.deadline, sdk.budget, sdk.hops).

StopReason.description: Structured stop reason. Required on a RunResult whose status is not completed.

CallerKind.description: Closed. anonymous exists only in an AccessQuestion.

actors.description: Agents that acted for this caller, verified from the credential: first delegate first, the agent presenting the credential last. Absent or empty: no delegation known. Since 1.1.

PublicCaller.description: A caller without its credential: what guards, events and access questions see. The credential is never serialised.

id.description: Identifier of the acting agent at the issuer (an OAuth client id, a workload id).

kind.description: agent in practice; user when a person acts for another.

issuer.description: Who vouches for this entry, when it differs from the credential's issuer.

Actor.description: One agent (or person) in a caller's delegation chain. Since 1.1.

deadlineAt.description: Local clock time by which the run must end. Absent only when the run has no deadline (limits.run.timeoutMs unbounded and none sent).

hops.description: Agent-to-agent calls before this run: 0 for a run a person or an event started.

tokens.description: Tokens (input plus output) the run may still spend, delegated runs included. Absent: no token budget.

costUsd.description: Spend in US dollars the run may still incur, delegated runs included. Absent: no cost budget.

reserved.description: What calls to other agents in flight have reserved and not yet settled.

Bounds.description: CallContext.bounds: deadline, remaining budget and hop count of a run, a read view of the run's ledger kept by the host. Since 1.1.

rootRunId.description: Id of the run that started the chain.

parentRunId.description: Id of the run of the agent that called this one.

Lineage.description: CallContext.lineage: where a run sits in a chain of agents. Since 1.1.

remainingMs.description: Time left, in milliseconds. Never a clock time.

hops.description: Agent-to-agent calls in the chain including this one.

Delegation.description: What one agent passes on to the next: what is left of its run's bounds (outboundBounds), and what a channel hands the host as CallContext.delegation. It can only tighten the receiving stack's limits. Since 1.1.

AnonymousCaller.description: The caller of a request without a verified identity. Explicit, never the agent.

RunInput.description: What a run starts from: a text, or a list of messages.
